description:
BUILD SPEC (cold-reviewed 2026-09-01, ACCEPT-WITH-CHANGES; proposal +
review report in session scratchpad kdt106-proposal.md + review
artifacts kdt106-review-*.{patch,tsv,fz}; review harness patch offers
FZ_KDT106_MODE x FZ_AGENDA env switching for re-measurement).

MECHANISM (probe-verified at 1d44ac7cd): FIFO settles the erased
List.reduce_while_step spec at 1 wide row -- 10 accumulated rows crossed
ACTIVATION_INPUT_ROW_BUDGET=8 and collapsed columnwise; 7 of the 10 were
ONE caller's ascent LADDER (conclude_preserving_frontier +
join-on-upsert keeps every superseded conclusion's row), the 4th
contributor was a wide key minted by an UPSTREAM collapse (cascade).
LIFO's 8 rows sat at budget by luck -> 3 narrow targets. Chains are the
schedule-visible part; per-callsite maxima are schedule-independent.

TWO FIX SHAPES REFUTED BY PROTOTYPE (do not rebuild): replace-on-conclude
and subsumption-gated ascent-replace BOTH non-settle (12,401 collapse
ping-pong across the 8/9-row budget cliff through the cont<->step
2-cycle; 49,714 aggregate movements). Grow-only row sets are load-bearing
for termination; the fix must be inflationary.

THE FIX: dominance absorption at the single chokepoint
ActivationInputAlternatives::insert_row -- a dominated incoming row is
not inserted; standing rows dominated by the incoming row leave with its
landing.

THE RELATION (the review's correction -- NOT bare is_subtype, NOT
has_vars parity): on Types per feedback-types-is-the-calculator:

  Types::row_column_dominates(sub, dom) :=
      sub == dom
      || ( free_var_ids(sub) == free_var_ids(dom)
           && lit_arrow_shapes(sub) SUBSET-OF lit_arrow_shapes(dom)
           && is_subtype(sub, dom) )
  Types::row_dominates(&[Ty], &[Ty]) = equal arity + every column

where lit_arrow_shapes(t) = sorted deduped set of
(fn_id, captures, args, ret) over every ClosureLit-tagged ArrowSig in
t's funcs axis (SUBSET not equality: the ladder's closure column grows
by ADDING literals, which must still absorb). Memoize
row_column_dominates via a NEW NON-SYMMETRIC
ComparisonKey::RowColumnDominates (do not route through symmetric_key;
do not memoize the row-level lift; do not memoize
free_var_ids/lit_arrow_shapes in round one -- cost measured in noise).

WHY THE CLOSURE-LITERAL CONJUNCT (record in the code comment):
emptiness.rs::func_clause_empty (~:191-219) decides P\N for a negative
arrow carrying a ClosureLit from fn_id + captures ALONE -- args/ret are
never read -- so is_subtype reports a ground arrow and a var-carrying
template arrow over ONE lambda as EQUIVALENT (trace-proven on
range_map; 8 corpus fixtures exhibit equiv-not-dom pairs: 52 on 00277,
46 enum_map_family, 30 range_map, 16 00420). Unguarded absorption
dropped with_index's template row -> misrouted element families -> JIT
tag panic (compiler2_jit_preserves_correlated_with_index_mapper_rows).
The var-parity prototype guard worked by corpus luck; the relation above
is the defensible form. TERMINATION IS EMPIRICAL NOT PROVEN (denotation
monotonicity fails on closure-lit columns where is_subtype is not
denotational) -- say so in the doc; corpus-wide mutual-dominance count is
0 and the relation is transitive, so the antichain op is confluent by
construction.

insert_row's existing whole-row equivalence skip STAYS (it is a DISTINCT
judgement: is_equivalent accepts pairs row_dominates rejects) but its
comment ("only permitted compression is whole-row EQUIVALENCE...
deliberately NOT template subsumption") is now FALSE and must be
REWRITTEN, documenting which judgement is authoritative and pointing at
fz-0za (the fold decision + the pre-existing arrival-order hole it
measures). Strip ALL prototype cruft -- the parked patch's
conclude_replacing_values_preserving_frontier (an inert clone whose doc
claims refuted replace semantics), absorb_conclusion, apply_absorbing,
probe_* methods, K: Debug widening, eprintlns -- BUILD FROM CLEAN BASE,
not from the patch.

EXPECTED MOVEMENT (review-measured with the recommended relation,
MODE=litaware): predicate 217->203 FIFO==LIFO BYTE-IDENTICAL; 00183
53->53; range_map 59 flat; 00420 207->215 -- A RISE, +8 executables,
PAIRED with budget collapses 30->0 on that fixture and byte-identical
stdout (interp+JIT+AOT): classified acceptable per the classification
gate (a rise is acceptable exactly when paired with a collapse reduction
on that fixture; rationale recorded in fz-zih). Corpus: 0 stdout
movements over 577 fixtures, budget collapses 3 fixtures -> 0
corpus-wide, wall clock 0.85-1.02x everywhere + 106x on the collapse-
cascade stress shape (172.8s -> 1.6s, 526->588 execs). 00277 is OUT OF
SCOPE (its gap = incomparable transient rows at fz-kdt.107's 3-arm
same-predicate callsite; re-homed there).

ACCEPTANCE:
1. Red-first unit tests at the antichain: (a) ascending ladder leaves
   only its maximum (RED at base); (b) template row + ground sibling
   both survive; (c) two rows differing only in args/ret of arrows over
   the SAME fn_id both survive, comment naming func_clause_empty (the
   guard against 'simplifying' back to is_subtype).
2. Schedule-confluence on FOUR lenses (predicate, 00420, 00183,
   range_map) FIFO vs LIFO byte-identical canon -- reuse the kdt.104/105
   LIFO-red lib-test harness pattern; RED at base on predicate.
3. compiler2_jit_preserves_correlated_with_index_mapper_rows green; full
   lib/cli/matrix gates green; 577-fixture stdout sweep byte-identical
   (JIT door for 00277 per fz-kdt.111).
4. Classification gate, NOT no-rise gate: every canon mover classified
   into {fewer execs | same execs with narrower types/fewer params |
   more execs paired with collapse reduction}; anything else = STOP. All
   14 movers enumerated in the close record
   (kdt106-review-sweep-canon.tsv).
5. Pins re-pinned w/ recipes + causes: inventory 217->203 (+ 00420
   207->215), claims 174->172.
6. Budget-collapse observation via telemetry event (fz-0xp -- may land
   in-story, then close fz-0xp as absorbed): 0 corpus-wide after.
7. Ratchets re-measured; fz-kdt.110 re-measure rider.

RECONCILIATION RIDERS (tickets to touch at close): fz-kdt.65 rewrite
(its predicate-widening instance is REPAIRED -- verified, the wide cone
gone, guarded-FIFO differs from base-LIFO by exactly the 32-line/16-pair
boundary-arg-lane coherence gain; return-ladder reset question stands);
fz-kdt.64/82 riders (NOT dissolved; 64's decision easier post-106 --
the pressure that made narrowing look necessary is gone); fz-kdt.108
re-measure after (106 changes its input); fz-kdt.110 re-measure.

comments.text: fz-kdt.105 measurement (post-landing, door = fz2 interp --dump backend=, release build): the FIFO-vs-LIFO key-set gap on enum_predicate_search falls from 35 keys to exactly 14. Base fba7d72e3: FIFO 217 keys, LIFO 182, 35 FIFO-only. With canonical clause order: FIFO 217, LIFO 203, 14 FIFO-only, zero LIFO-only. Every one of the surviving 14 carries the same over-wide join 'int | :false | :ok | :true' (Enum.all?/1#lambda@4125-4170/2, three Enum.all?/2#lambda@4286-4337/2, Enum.all_value_step/1, Enum.empty?/1#lambda@4753-4792/2, Kernel.</2, Kernel.==/2, Kernel.fz_op_eq/2, Kernel.fz_op_lt/2 and siblings) -- i.e. the 21 that vanished were the clause-ORDER class and the 14 that remain are exactly this ticket's transient-wide-join class, now isolated with nothing else mixed in. 00420 and 00183 are fully key-confluent FIFO vs LIFO at both base and head.
